minutes.headline: Committee to assess space needs via department survey before choosing between renovating Ritter or building at TC Pasquale's
minutes.summary: The Building Design Committee discussed the status of a department-heads survey meant to establish square-footage needs for a possible new or renovated town hall, and debated two competing site options: renovating the existing Ritter building versus building at the TC Pasquale's (Paseos) property, with a possible future link to a vacated Turkey Hill school. No design or site decision was made; members agreed to wait for survey results and reconvene on June 15, citing the recent override failure and the town's budget constraints as reasons to avoid further design spending for now.
